name: analytics
title: Analytics: many-vertex reads
expect: Chunked (All-Chunked) in ops; Condensed adjacency (Split/Condensed) in bytes
why: the reads touch many vertices: many friend lists (nhop2), the firstName of every Person (entry_eq_scan), a person's posts and their likers. Chunked packs many owners into one chunk, so one SEEK serves many of them: the name scan drops from {scan_dg} ops to {scan_ch}. The price is bytes: whole chunks are read ({ch_bytes} against {dg_bytes} for Split/Condensed).
